transcript.content: Hello! I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?
I've just been feeling incredibly depressed and sad lately. It's been going on for about 11 months now, and I just can't seem to shake this constant low mood.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—incredibly energetic, hyper, or on top of the world, even without much sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have only been feeling really down, empty, and depressed.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life, or did they seem to develop without any clear trigger?
I can't really recall any specific stressful event or trigger that started these feelings. They just seemed to develop on their own, and they have been persisting like this for about 11 months now.
Before these past 11 months, have you ever had a period of two years or more where you felt consistently down, sad, or low most of the time?

No, I don't recall ever having a period of feeling consistently down or sad for two years or more before this current episode started. Prior to these past 11 months, I didn't experience that kind of long-term low mood.
Since you've been feeling down, have you heard voices or seen things that others couldn't, or had strong beliefs that other people found unusual?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I haven't heard any voices, seen things that aren't there, or held any unusual beliefs.
Have you also noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in the hobbies and activities I used to love. Even when I try to do them, I don't feel any pleasure or happiness from them anymore. It all just feels completely empty.
How has your sleep been over these past several months? Have you been having trouble sleeping, or perhaps sleeping much more than usual?
Honestly, my sleep has been pretty normal. I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep patterns or had trouble sleeping lately.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking in energy lately, even if you haven't been doing much physical activity?
I can't say I've noticed feeling unusually tired or lacking in physical energy. My energy levels have been pretty much the same as usual.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite, or have you gained or lost weight without trying?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes in my appetite. My weight has stayed pretty much the same as well.
Have you been experiencing strong feelings of worthlessness, or perhaps feeling excessively or inappropriately guilty about things lately?
No, I haven't really experienced strong feelings of worthlessness or guilt. I just feel very empty and down, but I don't feel those specific emotions.
